title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：tendency　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tendency 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the researcher ① watched the tendency that no student in the lab would have noted, and he said the watching was the whole of the term. The ② tendency, meaning the trend itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed unnoted in the book; a tendency, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ tendency in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ tendency at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tendency, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the researcher said the noting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tendency was the whole of the matter, meaning the direction and not the trend. The ⑥ tendency, meaning the direction and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; tendency, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both a trend and a direction. He said the direction is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ tendency had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ tendency of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of noting; tendency, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tendency I remember is the trend noted in the paper, which closed in 1981 and is still noted as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ tendency, my mother said in 1983, is the only trend that improves by being noted; every tendency, she said, is a direction that has agreed to look like a trend. She said the direction was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 倾向；趋势（指实验室里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 倾向；趋势（指那种倾向本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch the tendency 观察这一种倾向
D. n. 倾向；趋势（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 倾向之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的倾向之事）
F. n. 倾向；趋势（指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一种）
G. n. 倾向、走向（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 走向（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: watched the tendency that no student in the lab would have noted
The tendency, meaning the trend itself and not the tube
the tendency at the far bench
the tendency was the whole of the matter
the tendency had become a line in a paper
The tendency of the whole thing
A tendency, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: watch the tendency 意为“观察这一种倾向”，1974 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯记下的一种倾向做了一遍。
tendency 意为“倾向；趋势”，指那种倾向本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。
tendency 意为“倾向；趋势”，指实验室里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
tendency 意为“倾向；趋势”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tendency 意为“倾向、走向”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种走向就是那件事的全部。
tendency 意为“走向”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种倾向，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tendency 意为“倾向；趋势”，指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一种，到 1979 年这一种成了研究报告里的一行。
tendency 意为“倾向之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的倾向之事是一处实验室和三个学期的记下。
tendency 意为“倾向；趋势”，我记得的是研究报告里记下过的那一种，1981 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一种。
tendency 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，倾向是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的倾向。
